title: The answer of a product's test gate
description: The JSON a gate command prints (incident-platform ADR-0060 D6, stage-4.md "4.3", backlog #0-275): today's scripts/factory/run-tests.sh of incident-platform. pass: the build and its tests passed; fixable: they failed, and the implementer gets the summary; stop: the environment failed, and a human looks. Every field is required and no other is allowed. Checked by dispatcher/src/schema/validate.mjs.

exitCode.description: The build's exit code; -1 when the gate stopped before it.

modules.description: The modules built, comma-separated; empty when none.

log.description: The build's log file; empty when there is none.

head.description: The commit tested; empty when the gate stopped before reading it.

artifact.description: The gate's artifact on a pass, null otherwise.
